g.text: A–B Vehicle fronts sampled on the road. A uses x − 28.8 t. Circles mark crossings. Shading spans the first preview to the last boundary crossing.
C–D Each square is one fitted staggered slot. Numbered dots are the measured vehicle fronts at the two dotted times. Lane centers are 3.3 m apart.
